title: Planning a Honeymoon in Tanzania
excerpt: Planning a honeymoon in Tanzania? How to choose the season, the route and the right mix of adventure and rest.
body:
## Why Tanzania

Wildlife, wide landscapes, intimate camps and the beaches of Zanzibar. Adventure and rest in one trip.

## Season

June–October and December–February are driest. The green season gives quieter camps.

## Route

- Safari: Tarangire, Serengeti, Ngorongoro.
- Beach: Zanzibar, Pemba or a small island.
- Optional: Kilimanjaro, for adventurous couples.

## Accommodation

Small camps with private verandas, outdoor showers and views.

## Experiences

See [romantic safari experiences](/blog/romantic-safari-experiences/) and [safari and beach honeymoon](/blog/safari-and-beach-honeymoon/).

## Budget

Prices on request; we put together a proposal that fits.

Read our [honeymoon page](/tanzania-honeymoon/) or [plan your honeymoon](/travel-proposal/).
